gate: multi-horizon validation — does the ICC result hold at 12, 24 and 36 months, or only at the horizon it was found on?

conventions_fixed_once_and_used_everywhe.why: Three gates in a row lost a condition to an unnamed convention: 'as-reported shares_t' (G0), 'within-sector rank result' (G1), '33.33 and 66.67 percentiles' (G2). Every convention this gate depends on is named here. If something below is still ambiguous, STOP AND ASK.
conventions_fixed_once_and_used_everywhe.quantile: NEAREST-RANK. For an ascending 0-indexed array of length n, the q-quantile is the element at index max(0, ceil(q*n) - 1). Terciles use q = 1/3 and 2/3. No interpolation.
conventions_fixed_once_and_used_everywhe.tercile_assignment: cell x goes to bucket 1 if value <= Q(1/3), bucket 2 if value <= Q(2/3), else bucket 3, evaluated in that order
conventions_fixed_once_and_used_everywhe.half_split: order the stratum ascending by ICC; H = the top ceil(n/2) elements, L = the remaining floor(n/2)
conventions_fixed_once_and_used_everywhe.ties: ties are broken by ascending symbol string, so every ordering is deterministic and reproducible
conventions_fixed_once_and_used_everywhe.spearman: Pearson correlation of average ranks; average ranks assign the mean position to tied values
conventions_fixed_once_and_used_everywhe.cluster_se: origin-clustered sandwich, V = inv(X'X) * sum_g (X_g' e_g)(X_g' e_g)' * inv(X'X)

what_is_frozen_and_what_varies.frozen: the model. GLS equation, forecast equations, ROE fade, terminal horizon T=12, payout policy, industry target, root solver, the ICC values themselves, and the market-cap basis settled in G0.
what_is_frozen_and_what_varies.varies: the realized return horizon only: 12, 24 and 36 months.
what_is_frozen_and_what_varies.all_three_are_computed_and_reported: Selection of a best horizon after seeing results is prohibited. A verdict that names one horizon must name it as a limitation, never as the finding.

the_overlap_structure_that_governs_this_.fact: Origins are spaced exactly one year apart at t-06-30. A 12-month realized window therefore does NOT overlap between adjacent origins; a 24-month window overlaps one year; a 36-month window overlaps two.
the_overlap_structure_that_governs_this_.effective_independent_periods: T_eff = T / h, with T = 5 origins and h the horizon in years. 12m gives 5.0, 24m gives 2.5, 36m gives 1.67.
the_overlap_structure_that_governs_this_.consequence_stated_before_any_result: The 12-month horizon is the only one of the three whose per-origin observations are statistically independent. Every prior result in this mission — R3, G1, G2 — was measured at 36 months, where the effective sample is under two periods. If the effect is real, 12 months is where it can be asserted most honestly; if it exists only at 36 months, that is a finding about overlapping windows, not about expected returns.
the_overlap_structure_that_governs_this_.reporting_requirement: Every reported statistic carries both raw n and T_eff.

coverage_verified_before_freezing.note: r3-panel closes extend to 2026-07-31, so the 2023 origin resolves at all three horizons. No horizon loses an origin to data availability.

primary_specification.regression: R_h ~ const + BP + SIZE + FEPS1_over_P + ForecastSlope + ICC, origin fixed effects, origin-clustered SEs
primary_specification.momentum_is_excluded_from_the_primary_an: Momentum requires a close twelve months before the origin, which drops 2019 entirely and reduces the sample to four origins. G3's question is horizon stability, and the 12-month horizon's independence advantage exists only with all five origins. Including momentum would discard exactly the origin that makes the honest test possible. The momentum specification is reported as a sensitivity at all three horizons.
primary_specification.R_h: ((P_{t+h} + sum of dividends over (t, t+h]) / P_t)^(1/h) - 1, annualized, r3-panel split-adjusted closes and r3-panel dividends, the same <=16-day staleness rule used throughout
primary_specification.sample: 1,638 cells, five origins, identical across the three horizons so that horizon is the only thing that changes

required_reports_per_horizon: pooled ICC coefficient, clustered t, raw n, T_eff
per-origin ICC coefficient and its sign, all five
Fama-MacBeth mean and NW lag-1 t, with T_eff stated alongside
rank IC: per-origin Spearman(ICC, R_h), the five values, their mean, and the count positive
ICC high-minus-low spread within B/P terciles, per origin, using EXCESS returns and the half-split convention above; report the count positive
sector-neutral estimate: the same regression with SIC2 fixed effects added and ICC entering in levels — the standard within estimator, which G1 established as the defensible reading
large-cap sensitivity: the same regression restricted to cells at or above the within-origin median SIZE (nearest-rank median), with n reported
momentum-specification sensitivity on the four origins where momentum exists

verdict_rules.G3_STABLE_ACROSS_HORIZONS: ALL of: (a) the pooled ICC coefficient is positive at all three horizons; (b) at the 12-month horizon specifically, the pooled coefficient is positive with clustered |t| >= 2 and the per-origin sign is positive at >= 4 of 5; (c) rank IC mean is positive at all three horizons; (d) the B/P-stratified high-minus-low spread is positive at >= 4 of 5 origins at the 12-month horizon.
verdict_rules.G3_HORIZON_SPECIFIC: the pooled coefficient is positive at 36 months but condition (b) fails at 12 months, or the sign of the pooled coefficient differs across horizons while remaining positive at 36
verdict_rules.G3_FAIL: the pooled ICC coefficient is negative at two or more horizons, or negative with clustered |t| >= 2 at the 12-month horizon
verdict_rules.why_12m_carries_the_weight: It is the only horizon whose origins do not overlap. A result that survives only where windows overlap is a result about the windows. This asymmetry is stated before any number is computed and is not a post-hoc preference.
verdict_rules.sector_neutral_and_large_cap_are_reporte: They are diagnostics for the artifact; G1 showed sector constructions are specification-sensitive, and a large-cap restriction halves the sample by design.

prohibitions: no post-result selection of a horizon
no post-result change to any threshold, convention, specification or sample rule
no change to the GLS equation, forecast equations, ROE fade, terminal horizon, payout policy, industry target, or solver
no re-solving of the ICC — G3 varies the realized horizon only
no publication or promotion; the public surface remains quarantined
